claim_boundary: The remaining case has either multiple floater supporters or a unique supporter separated from the source by weak-preference reachability; the lemma does not eliminate those cases.
corollary: At a maximum-Nash eligible state, a source-host blocker with a unique floater supporter cannot be reachable from the source in the weak bundle-preference graph.
lemma: Replace r in host bundle X_h by floater f. If exactly one agent i ranks f above r, i strictly prefers the modified host bundle, and the original weak bundle-preference graph has a simple path from h to i, rotate bundles along that path and give the modified bundle to i. The resulting one-floater state is EFX and eligible and has strictly larger Nash welfare.
